shopping.en: There are skyscrapers, busy shopping streets, trendy cafés, and a growing economy.
shopping.zh: 那里有摩天大楼、繁忙的商业街、时尚的咖啡馆，经济也在不断增长。

shopping.en: Basket spend is what you spend in one transaction on the things in your shopping basket.
shopping.zh: “客单价”是指你在一次交易中花在购物篮里物品上的钱。

shopping.en: Large crowds at events, in shopping centers, at transport hubs, are very difficult to manage without cameras.
shopping.zh: 如果没有摄像头，活动中、购物中心里、交通枢纽里的大量人群将很难管理。

shopping.en: In the 1980s, he even reportedly had a Concorde jet pick him up for shopping trips in Europe.
shopping.zh: 上世纪80年代，据传他甚至曾用协和飞机接送自己去欧洲购物。

shopping.en: Don't be silly...! Coming somewhere else to try and face my fears... maybe do a bit of shopping.
shopping.zh: 别开玩笑了……！换个地方继续直面我的恐惧……顺便逛逛街。

sharply.en: There are shortages in countries around the world, and oil prices have risen sharply.
sharply.zh: 世界各地的国家都出现了短缺，油价急剧上涨。

sharply.en: People who invested in overvalued AI companies could see their investments drop sharply in value.
sharply.zh: 投资于被高估的AI公司的投资者会看到他们的投资价值急剧下降。

sharply.en: Housing is really expensive. The cost of living has risen sharply.
sharply.zh: 住房价格非常昂贵。生活成本急剧上升。

sharply.en: Prices fell sharply. Banks failed or needed government bailouts.
sharply.zh: 价格急剧下跌。银行倒闭或需要政府救助。

sharply.en: If something spikes, it increases sharply.
sharply.zh: 如果某样东西“spikes”，意思是它急剧上升。

share.en: Non-identical, or fraternal, twins come from two separate eggs and share half their genes.
share.zh: 非同卵双胞胎（即异卵双胞胎）来自两个不同的卵子，共享一半的基因。

share.en: Ethnicity means the social, cultural and linguistic characteristics shared by a group of people.
share.zh: “族群”（Ethnicity）意味着一群人所共享的社会、文化和语言特征。

share.en: Here's Asifa again, sharing some examples of how we talk about smells with BBC Radio 4.
share.zh: 下面再次是 Asifa 在 BBC 广播四台分享的一些关于我们如何谈论气味的例子。

share.en: Here, Cara shares her findings with Caroline Steel from BBC World Service's CrowdScience.
share.zh: 在这里，Cara 与 BBC World Service 节目 CrowdScience 的 Caroline Steel 分享了她的发现。

share.en: You know, it's, I'm confident in being able to share what I'm experiencing.
share.zh: 你知道，我有信心分享我正在经历的事情。

shy.en: He was a shy but passionate boy. When he set his mind to something, he did it.
shy.zh: 他是一个害羞但充满热情的男孩。一旦他下定决心做某事，就一定会做到。

shy.en: And even to this day, I still get kind of shy when I'm around her and talking to her.
shy.zh: 直到今天，当我在她身边和她交谈时，我还是会觉得有点害羞。

shy.en: She was shy around Betsy DeVos. I was shy.
shy.zh: 她在Betsy DeVos面前很害羞。我很害羞。

shy.en: So, don't be shy! Get talking to others in English and if you make a mistake say, "No worries!" and carry on.
shy.zh: 所以，别害羞！试着用英语和别人交流，如果你犯了错，就说声“没关系！”，然后继续。

shy.en: That constituency only has around 75,000 registered voters, and he received just shy of 19,000 votes in the last election; he didn’t even receive a majority of votes in his own constituency.
shy.zh: 该选区只有大约75000名注册选民，他在上次选举中只获得了不到19000张选票；他甚至没有在他自己的选区获得多数票。

shut.en: To shut it down? All the time. Oh yeah? Oh yeah, all the time.
shut.zh: 去关闭它？一直想。哦，是吗？哦，是啊，一直都想。

shut.en: And finally, the phrasal verb to shut something down means to stop it.
shut.zh: 最后，短语动词 shut something down 意思是让某事停止。

shut.en: Because what else am I going to do? All of my nightclubs have been shut down.
shut.zh: 因为我还能做什么呢？我所有的夜总会都关门了。

shut.en: At Fukushima, the reactors had already shut themselves down, but the cooling failed, and the fuel melted.
shut.zh: 在福岛，反应堆已经自动关闭，但冷却系统失效，导致燃料熔毁。

shut.en: When children start talking about smells, especially unpleasant ones, parents often react by shutting the conversation down.
shut.zh: 当孩子开始谈论气味，尤其是难闻的气味时，家长往往会打断这个话题。

shade.en: It didn't, your culture didn't matter. All that mattered was your shade.
shade.zh: 你的文化并不重要。唯一重要的是你的肤色深浅。

shade.en: Some famous examples of self-published books include The Martian by Andy Weir and Fifty Shades of Grey by E.L.
shade.zh: 一些自主出版书籍的著名例子包括 Andy Weir 的《The Martian》和 E.L. James 的《Fifty Shades of Grey》。

shade.en: That was like my first big shade, my first solace, my first foothold that I started getting on success was that I didn't need to deserve it.
shade.zh: 那是我第一次感到释怀，是我第一次获得的慰藉，是我在通往成功之路上的第一个立足点，那就是我不需要“配得上”它。

shade.en: Dubai can't simply copy the Netherlands, and a range of measures, including water stations and shaded rest areas, have been created for cycling in the heat.
shade.zh: 迪拜不能简单地复制荷兰，为了适应炎热天气下的骑行，已经采取了一系列措施，包括水站和有遮阳的休息区。

shift.en: Because what’s happening in British immigration policy is part of a much bigger global shift.
shift.zh: 因为英国移民政策中发生的事情，其实是更大范围全球转变的一部分。

shift.en: The old logic of Françafrique might not have disappeared completely, but it has shifted.
shift.zh: “法属非洲”的旧逻辑或许尚未完全消失，但已经发生了转变。

shift.en: And when I'm putting in triple shifts is when I know I'm really gassing it.
shift.zh: 当我开启三倍轮班时，我就知道我真的在全力以赴了。

shift.en: We can train people to recognise that shift when they enter it.
shift.zh: 我们可以训练人们，在自己进入那种心理转变时能够察觉到它。

shift.en: She was always on the night shift, keeping her away from Angie and her sister.
shift.zh: 她总是上夜班，这让她无法陪伴Angie和她的姐姐。

shock.en: So did Britain, and so did, shock horror, the West’s archenemy the Soviet Union.
shock.zh: 英国也有，而且令人大惊失色的是，西方死敌苏联也有。

shock.en: You'll be shocked to realize that your back has been stuck for a while.
shock.zh: 你会惊讶地发现你的背部已经僵硬很久了。

shock.en: If the learner made a mistake, the teacher would administer an electric shock.
shock.zh: 如果“学生”答错了，“教师”就要对其施加电击。

shock.en: If you are taken aback by something, you are shocked or surprised by it.
shock.zh: 如果你对某事感到taken aback（大吃一惊），说明你对此感到震惊或惊讶。

shock.en: Trust us. Follow our instructions. The shock generator the teacher was shown looked convincing.
shock.zh: 相信我们，照我们说的做。“教师”看到的电击发生器，外观十分逼真可信。

shortcut.en: It's a mental shortcut. It's something that helps us navigate uncertain times or make quick choices.
shortcut.zh: 这是一种心理捷径。它能帮助我们在不确定的时期做出指引或快速抉择。

shortcut.en: So if you can teach children this philosophy at an early age, you shortcut all the debates.
shortcut.zh: 所以如果你能从小教给孩子这种哲学，就能省去所有的争论。

shortcut.en: How do you shortcut that desire contract? you could focus, you could decide that I don't want most things.
shortcut.zh: 你该如何走捷径跳过这个欲望的契约？你可以专注于此，你可以决定我绝大多数东西都不想要。

shortcut.en: Ben says that endorsements work as a mental shortcut.
shortcut.zh: Ben表示，代言就像是一种心理捷径。

shortcut.en: I heard him say that. And I just love that as a refrain, which is that a lot of people look for a shortcut.
shortcut.zh: 我听他说过。我非常喜欢这句话作为座右铭，因为很多人都在寻找捷径。

shape.en: Under Lee Kuan Yew, the government took an active role in shaping Singapore’s development.
shape.zh: 在李光耀的领导下，政府在塑造新加坡的发展中发挥了积极作用。

shape.en: And it was during this time that the modern perfume industry began to take shape.
shape.zh: 正是在这段时间里，现代香水产业开始成形。

shape.en: Culturally, they have been shaped by centuries of African, Arab, and French influence.
shape.zh: 在文化上，它们几个世纪以来一直受到非洲、阿拉伯和法国的影响。

shape.en: Others might just shape the way we live and speak for many years to come.
shape.zh: 而另一些，可能会在未来很多年里，持续塑造我们的生活方式和语言表达。

shape.en: He didn’t just fight. He manipulated. He shaped the battlefield to his advantage.
shape.zh: 他不只是战斗。他操纵局势。他将战场塑造对自已有利的形态。

sharpen.en: When we come back, how to sharpen our emotional intelligence?
sharpen.zh: 节目稍后回来，我们将聊聊如何磨练我们的情商。

sharpen.en: If you say that a difficult situation sharpens or concentrates someone's mind, you mean that it makes them think clearly.
sharpen.zh: 如果你说一个困难的情况使某人的思维变得敏锐或集中，你的意思是它使他们能够清晰地思考。

sharpen.en: The phrase concentrate or sharpen the mind means to think more clearly about something, like an actor or an athlete feeling nerves before a big performance can help them do their best.
sharpen.zh: “集中”或“敏锐思维”短语意指对某事思考得更清晰，就像演员或运动员在大表演前感到紧张可以帮助他们发挥出最好水平一样。

shortage.en: There are shortages in countries around the world, and oil prices have risen sharply.
shortage.zh: 世界各地的国家都出现了短缺，油价急剧上涨。

shortage.en: There were food shortages, strict rationing and inflation that affected millions of civilians.
shortage.zh: 出现了粮食短缺、严格的配给制和通货膨胀，影响了数百万平民。

shortage.en: There are still job shortages where sponsorship is possible even without degrees.
shortage.zh: 仍然存在即使没有学位也可以进行担保的人才短缺岗位。

shortage.en: There’s high government debt, housing shortages, and now the rise of the Reform UK political party.
shortage.zh: 政府债务高企、住房短缺，现在还有英国改革党这一政党的崛起。

shortage.en: Prices usually increase because countries and companies worry about these shortages.
shortage.zh: 由于各国和各大公司对这些短缺感到担忧，价格通常会上涨。

shoulder.en: In English, it would be things like turn, stop, look over your shoulder.
shoulder.zh: 在英语中，就是转弯、停车、回头看之类的话。

shoulder.en: Terms for the “road”, terms for “lanes”, terms for the “shoulder” at the edge of a road.
shoulder.zh: 关于“道路”的术语，“车道”的术语，路边缘“路肩”的术语。

shoulder.en: Or like he carries his bag on that shoulder and I carry mine on this shoulder.
shoulder.zh: 或者他把包背在那边肩膀上，而我背在这边肩膀上。

shoulder.en: Or like he carries his bag on that shoulder and I carry mine on this shoulder.
shoulder.zh: 或者他把包背在那边肩膀上，而我背在这边肩膀上。

shoulder.en: For me, it was a conflict, like I'd got a devil and an angel on my shoulders.
shoulder.zh: 对我来说，这是一种冲突，就像我的肩膀上坐着一个恶魔和一个天使。

shiver.en: It was a slaughter. The Romans were soaked, shivering, and unorganised.
shiver.zh: 这是一场屠杀。罗马人浑身湿透、瑟瑟发抖且毫无阵型。

shiver.en: They are far less likely to shiver. So, do the reindeer herders deal better with the cold?
shiver.zh: 他们发抖的可能性要小得多。那么，驯鹿牧民能更好地应对寒冷吗？

shiver.en: And finally, a shiver is the shaking movement made by your muscles when you feel cold or afraid.
shiver.zh: 最后，shiver（发抖）是指当你感到寒冷或害怕时，肌肉做出的颤抖动作。

shaky.en: Lumumba was technically the Prime Minister, but his hold on the country was shaky at best.
shaky.zh: 卢蒙巴名义上是总理，但他对国家的控制力可以说是岌岌可危。

shaky.en: Reindeer herders are less likely to shiver – the shaky movement that cold muscles make to try and warm them up.
shaky.zh: 驯鹿牧民不太容易发抖（shiver）——即寒冷的肌肉为了试图让自己暖和起来而做出的颤抖动作。

shaky.en: Polls from late 2011 showed a mixed picture—about 30% of Egyptians backed them, far ahead of any rival, but trust was shaky, with many fearing an Islamist agenda was hidden behind the smiles and promises of prosperity.
shaky.zh: 2011 年底的民意调查显示出一幅复杂的画面——大约 30% 的埃及人支持他们，远远领先于任何竞争对手，但信任并不稳固，许多人担心在微笑和繁荣的承诺背后隐藏着一个伊斯兰主义议程。

shake.en: So, the ground is shaking, music is blasting, and thousands of fans are dancing.
shake.zh: 所以，地面在震动，音乐在轰鸣，成千上万的粉丝在跳舞。

shake.en: They twitched and shook, cried out in pain, and complained of being pinched or bitten.
shake.zh: 她们抽搐颤抖，痛苦哭喊，抱怨自己被掐或被咬。

shake.en: Milgram was shaken. He repeated the experiment multiple times, varying the conditions.
shake.zh: 米尔格拉姆本人也被震撼到了。他多次重复这项实验，并不断改变实验条件。

shake.en: He was frequently hassled and shaken down for bribes, forced to pay money to the police.
shake.zh: 他经常受到骚扰和勒索敲诈，被迫向警察交钱。

shake.en: And he worked his way around the perimeter of the room, shaking hands with everyone.
shake.zh: 他沿着房间的四周走了一圈，逐一和大家握手。

shelter.en: A prepper might learn survival skills or they might build a bunker – an underground shelter.
shelter.zh: 生存主义者可能会学习生存技能，或者建造地堡——一种地下避难所。

shelter.en: What followed was a massacre. Several thousand people were killed: soldiers, civilians, and Catholic clergy sheltering inside the town.
shelter.zh: 随之而来的是一场大屠杀。数千人被杀：包括士兵、平民以及在镇内避难的天主教神职人员。

shelter.en: You're right Neil! The property is said to include a large underground bunker, although Zuckerberg says it's just a little shelter.
shelter.zh: 你说对了，Neil！据说这处房产包含一个大型地下地堡，尽管 Zuckerberg 说那只是个小避难所。

shelter.en: I think the simplest definition of poverty is not having enough resources, money, or food or shelter, to live with dignity.
shelter.zh: 我认为，贫困最简单的定义就是没有足够的资源、金钱、食物或住所来维持有尊严的生活。

shelter.en: They had existed in various forms since the early 1700s as places where the destitute could go to receive food and shelter in exchange for work.
shelter.zh: 早在 18 世纪初，它们就以各种形式存在了，是赤贫者可以去那里以工作换取食物和住所的地方。

shorten.en: Shorten them. Open them up. And don’t be afraid to ask one more follow up.
shorten.zh: 把它们变短。把它们变成开放式。并且不要害怕再多问一个追问。

shorten.en: Jayne uses the adjective glam as a shortened form of the word, glamour, meaning attractive and exciting.
shorten.zh: 杰恩用形容词 glam 作为 glamour（迷人、激动人心）的缩写，意思是迷人和吸引人。

shorten.en: Many historians believe this work, Turing’s work, shortened the war by 2 to 4 years, saving millions of lives in the process.
shorten.zh: 许多历史学家认为，这项工作——Turing 的工作——将战争缩短了 2 到 4 年，在此过程中拯救了数百万人的生命。

shorten.en: And he did all of this while also shortening World War II, the most devastating conflict in history, by multiple years.
shorten.zh: 而且，在做到这一切的同时，他还将人类历史上最具毁灭性的冲突——第二次世界大战缩短了数年时间。

shorten.en: If extending a year or shortening it could help them stay in power or delay an opponent’s election, they would simply adjust the calendar to suit their needs.
shorten.zh: 如果延长或缩短一年能帮助他们保持权力或推迟对手的选举，他们就会简单地调整日历来满足自己的需求。

shatter.en: To shatter an illusion is to destroy someone's misconceptions, causing them to realise an unpleasant reality.
shatter.zh: 打破幻觉（To shatter an illusion）是指摧毁某人的错误观念，使他们意识到一个令人不快的现实。

shatter.en: If something shatters your illusions, it destroys a false belief you hold, making you realise an unpleasant truth.
shatter.zh: 如果某事打破了你的幻觉，它就摧毁了你持有的一种错误信念，让你意识到一个令人不快的事实。

shatter.en: It shattered. It basically missed the bottom of the brain.
shatter.zh: 它破碎了。它基本上错过了大脑的底部。

shatter.en: Power was officially moving vertically —from father to son— shattering the seven-decade-old tradition of horizontal, brother-to-brother succession.
shatter.zh: 权力正式开始垂直过渡——从父亲传给儿子，粉碎了持续了七十年的兄弟之间水平继承的传统。

sharp.en: Adventure playgrounds have lots of small dangers: hard pieces of wood, sharp metal, nails.
sharp.zh: 冒险游乐场有很多小危险：硬木头、尖锐的金属、钉子。

sharp.en: Yeah, there has been a very sharp increase.
A spike is a sharp, pointed shape. If you see it on a line graph, it means that something has increased very rapidly.
sharp.zh: Spike是一个尖锐的点状形状。如果你在线形图上看到它，意味着某事增长得非常迅速。

sharp.en: Their teeth became smaller. Their ears, which were previously sharp and upright to catch the sound of prey, began to flop over.
sharp.zh: 它们的牙齿变小了。它们的耳朵原本是为了捕捉猎物声音而竖立着的尖耳，现在开始耷拉下来。

sharp.en: One key technique he used was Sfumato, which is a method of softly blending colors and tones so that there are no sharp lines.
sharp.zh: 他使用的关键技术之一是晕涂法（Sfumato），这是一种柔和地融合颜色和色调、使画面没有生硬线条的方法。

shelf.en: It's never new insights about how to put up level shelves or charmingly introduce yourself at a cocktail party.
shelf.zh: 从来都不是关于如何安装架子或在鸡尾酒会上如何迷人地介绍自己的新见解。

shelf.en: Ruth casts her eye over the supermarket shelves.
shelf.zh: Ruth在仔细打量超市的货架。

shelf.en: That little bottle on the shelf has been carefully positioned to make you feel like you’re not just buying a fragrance but a piece of a glamorous world.
shelf.zh: 货架上的那个小瓶子经过精心定位，让你觉得你买的不仅是一种香水，更是一个魅力世界的一部分。

shame.en: And I do find that there’s only shame in it if you feel shame.
shame.zh: 我确实发现，只有当你感到羞耻时，它才会有羞耻感。

shame.en: And I do find that there’s only shame in it if you feel shame.
shame.zh: 我确实发现，只有当你感到羞耻时，它才会有羞耻感。

shame.en: Then like rage, helplessness, even like shame, feeling like I didn't protect her.
shame.zh: 然后是愤怒，无助，甚至像羞耻，觉得我没有保护她。

shame.en: And so is it a shame that we can't do that in person as well?
shame.zh: 噢，当然。我认为这是限制男性发展的最大因素。

shame.en: And that's a shame. But as you say, that's another story.
shame.zh: 这真是件憾事。不过就像你说的，那是另一个话题了。

shark.en: Sharks aren't the only migratory animal that acts as a secret weapon against climate change.
shark.zh: 鲨鱼并不是唯一能充当对抗气候变化'秘密武器'的迁徙动物。

shark.en: Sophie goes on to ask whether sharks travel across huge swathes of ocean.
shark.zh: Sophie 接着问，鲨鱼是否会横跨大片海域(huge swathes of ocean)。

shark.en: Whereas if you are a shark, you will eventually find yourself swimming entirely amongst sharks.
shark.zh: 而如果你是一条鲨鱼，你最终会发现自己完全在鲨鱼群中游弋。

shark.en: Whereas if you are a shark, you will eventually find yourself swimming entirely amongst sharks.
shark.zh: 而如果你是一条鲨鱼，你最终会发现自己完全在鲨鱼群中游弋。

shark.en: Fish, octopus, squid, sharks, whales, creatures of all shapes and sizes.
shark.zh: 鱼类、章鱼、乌贼、鲨鱼、鲸鱼，各种形状和大小的生物。

shot.en: A shot is fired. Abdallah is dead, while Denard is wounded in the hand.
shot.zh: 枪声响起。Ahmed Abdallah 身亡，而 Bob Denard 的手部受伤。

shot.en: No. Turmeric? No. Ginger shots? No. This is a very, very good quiz!
shot.zh: 没有。姜黄？没有。生姜汁？没有。这是一个非常非常好的测验！

shot.en: He was seriously injured four times, and was shot in the head twice.
shot.zh: 他曾四次身受重伤，头部两次中弹。

shot.en: Yeah. And she'd been shot point blank in the head by this man.
shot.zh: 是的。她被这个男人近距离开枪击中了头部。

shot.en: To make matters worse, the military wasn’t exactly thrilled to see an Islamist calling the shots.
shot.zh: 更糟糕的是，军方对于看到一个伊斯兰主义者发号施令可是一点也不高兴。

shrink.en: He's like, and when you win, that's when you become so big that they shrink into irrelevance.
shrink.zh: 他说：当你赢了，你就变得如此强大，以至于他们萎缩到无关紧要。

shrink.en: So by the early sixteenth century, meaningful English control had shrunk back to a narrow strip around Dublin.
shrink.zh: 因此，到 16 世纪初，英国的实质控制范围已缩减至都柏林周围的一条狭长地带。

shrink.en: Its population is ageing and shrinking, with a quarter of the population aged over 65 and just 12% under the age of 14.
shrink.zh: 它的人口正在老龄化且不断萎缩，四分之一的人口年龄超过65岁，而14岁以下的儿童仅占12%。

shrink.en: And if the workforce is shrinking, then you have a small number of people exactly who are supporting a large number of retirees.
shrink.zh: 如果劳动力在萎缩，那么你就有一小部分人正好在支持大量退休人员。

shrink.en: And then there were the layoffs. DOGE didn’t just want to modernise technology; it wanted to shrink the federal workforce dramatically.
shrink.zh: 接下来就是裁员。DOGE 不仅想实现技术现代化；它还想大幅缩减联邦员工队伍。

sheet.en: Everybody’s wearing sneakers and T-shirts, there are sign-up sheets for picnics and poker groups.
sheet.zh: 每个人都穿着运动鞋和 T 恤，有野餐和扑克俱乐部的报名表。

sheet.en: The booth can be a single striped canvas sheet thrown over a frame.
sheet.zh: 这个布罩可以只是一张套在框架上的红白条纹帆布。

shortly.en: The hydrogen bomb, which was developed shortly after, was literally hundreds of times more powerful.
shortly.zh: 随后不久研制出的氢弹，威力实际上是前者的数百倍。

shortly.en: Ulbricht first had the idea for such a marketplace shortly after finishing university at Penn State.
shortly.zh: Ulbricht 在宾夕法尼亚州立大学毕业后不久，首次萌生了建立这样一个市场的想法。

shortly.en: Most were murdered shortly after they arrived as part of the Holocaust.
shortly.zh: 作为大屠杀的一部分，大多数人在抵达后不久就被谋杀了。

shortly.en: He was, they said, in a coma, and had been since shortly after his trial in March 2016.
shortly.zh: 他们说，他一直处于昏迷状态，而且从2016年3月审判结束后不久就已经如此。

shortly.en: I made the decision that shortly after the election I would leave.
shortly.zh: 我做出了决定，在大选后不久我就会离开。

sheriff.en: The county sheriff, a man named Johnny Behan, was sympathetic to the Cowboys.
sheriff.zh: 县警长 Johnny Behan 对“牛仔帮”抱有同情。

sheriff.en: The dominant genre was the Western. Cowboys and sheriffs and open plains.
sheriff.zh: 当时最主流的电影类型是西部片：牛仔、警长，还有辽阔的平原。

shuttle.en: He operates a profitable commercial air shuttle between the Comoros and apartheid South Africa, which was heavily sanctioned at the time.
shuttle.zh: 他在科摩罗和当时遭受严重制裁的种族隔离制度下的南非之间经营着一条利润丰厚的商业客运航空专线。

shadow.en: It was coming from Otto. He was a shadow of his former self.
shadow.zh: 那声音正是来自奥托。他已经不再是原来的样子，只剩一个影子般的躯壳。

shadow.en: You cast a shadow that no one even can see them behind you.
shadow.zh: 你投下的阴影让没人能看到你身后的他们。

shadow.en: And he wasn’t operating in the shadows, hiding in ditches or secretly breaking into apartments to gain intelligence.
shadow.zh: 而且他并不是在阴影中行动，躲在壕沟里或秘密潜入公寓去获取情报。

shadow.en: It became a symbol of the dangers of nuclear energy and cast a long shadow over the nuclear industry.
shadow.zh: 它成为了核能危险的象征，并给核工业投下了长长的阴影。

shadow.en: A lot of practice. You need to spend a lot of time repeating sounds, shadowing audio, understanding common mistakes.
shadow.zh: 大量的练习。你需要花大量时间重复发音、进行影子跟读、理解常见错误。

shave.en: His hair had been shaved off, he was hooked up with tubes, he was blind and deaf.
shave.zh: 他的头发被剃光了，身上插满了各种管子，双目失明，双耳失聪。

shell.en: The oldest Chinese writing examples were carved into animal bones and turtle shells.
shell.zh: 最古老的中国文字例子是被刻在动物骨头和乌龟壳上的。

shell.en: Inflation soared, debt piled up, and the state became little more than an empty shell.
shell.zh: 通货膨胀飙升，债务堆积如山，国家沦空壳一个。

shell.en: We have found these symbols carved into animal bones and turtle shells.
shell.zh: 我们在动物骨头和乌龟壳上发现了这些刻下的符号。

shell.en: But whatever had happened, he left North Korea a shell of the person who had arrived seventeen months earlier.
shell.zh: 但无论发生了什么，他离开朝鲜时，已经只是17个月前那个抵达朝鲜的人的一具空壳。

shell.en: Similarly, the giant tortoises on each island had different shell shapes, and locals could often identify a tortoise’s island simply by looking at its shell.
shell.zh: 同样，每个岛上的巨龟都有不同的外壳形状，当地人通常只需看一眼龟壳就能认出乌龟来自哪个岛。

shrug.en: His mum shrugged and said she didn’t really know why he said this, and it seems like there is no definite answer to what it means.
shrug.zh: 他妈妈耸耸肩，说她也不太清楚他为什么会这么说，看起来这个词到底是什么意思，确实没有一个明确的答案。

shower.en: Um, I didn't have a shower. I didn't have a shower to go to the YMCA to go shower.
shower.zh: 我没有淋浴间。我没有淋浴间，得去YMCA洗澡。

shower.en: Um, I didn't have a shower. I didn't have a shower to go to the YMCA to go shower.
shower.zh: 我没有淋浴间。我没有淋浴间，得去YMCA洗澡。

shower.en: Today we live in a world where most people have showers in their houses, soap is cheap, deodorant is everywhere, and there really is no valid reason to not wash yourself regularly.
shower.zh: 今天我们生活在一个大多数人家里都有淋浴、肥皂很便宜、除臭剂随处可见的世界里，不经常洗澡确实没有什么合理的理由。

shower.en: And there’s more. Water use might be a non-issue in the wet and rainy country of Scotland, but in countries less blessed by constant showers and flowing rivers, it is.
shower.zh: 不仅如此。在湿润多雨的苏格兰，水资源利用可能不是个问题，但在那些没有经常下雨和流淌河流眷顾的国家里，它就是个问题。

shower.en: So, is this actually true? Are the good people of Scotland in danger of having to go without a shower because the water has all been used for your and my ChatGPT queries?
shower.zh: 所以，这真的是真的吗？苏格兰的好心人们真的面临没水洗澡的危险吗？因为水全都被你我的 ChatGPT 查询给用光了？

sheer.en: These city-states were frequently at war with each other, whether over trade, territory, or sheer political rivalry.
sheer.zh: 这些城邦经常彼此交战，无论是为了贸易、领土，还是纯粹的政治竞争。

sheer.en: So you're scrambling to sell them. And you're just going off sheer relationships you have with these guys.
sheer.zh: 所以你手忙脚乱地想把它们卖出去。你只能完全依靠你和这些家伙之间的私人交情。

sheer.en: And the sheer scale of the growth in AI, and the data centres required for this, is mindboggling.
sheer.zh: 人工智能增长的绝对规模，以及为此所需的数据中心，简直令人匪夷所思。

sheer.en: Amid the mud, blood, and sheer senselessness of it all, Fawcett began to question the supposed superiority of Western progress.
sheer.zh: 在一片泥泞、血腥和毫无意义的混乱之中，Fawcett 开始质疑西方进步所谓的优越性。

sheer.en: In the immediate aftermath, there were movements to try to undo some of the damage, or at least acknowledge the sheer insanity of it.
sheer.zh: 在那之后的短期内，出现了一些试图弥补部分损失的行动，或者至少承认了那种彻头彻尾的疯狂。

shield.en: Water is needed to keep astronauts hydrated, as well as for cooling and regulating the temperature of a spacecraft, and as a radiation shield.
shield.zh: 我们需要水来保证宇航员的水分供应，用于冷却和调节航天器的温度，以及作为辐射屏蔽层。

shield.en: Though they were originally supporting troops, many of them had been trained and equipped in the Roman style, with long spears, oval shields, and discipline drilled into them by years of warfare.
shield.zh: 虽然他们最初只是支援部队，但其中许多人已经接受了罗马风格的训练和装备，配备长矛、椭圆形盾牌，并且经过多年战事的洗礼，纪律严明。

shield.en: And I was just going at it. And I'm really glad and I'm lucky that I got to do that because it sort of shielded me from some of the panic that came with the pandemic of what are you doing?
shield.zh: 我只是在做。我真的很高兴，我很幸运我能做到这一点，因为它在某种程度上保护我免受疫情带来的一些恐慌，你在做什么？

shadowy.en: As it turns out, Clarence's friends, acquaintances and shadowy criminal contacts would have been right not to lend him the money.
shadowy.zh: 事实证明，Clarence 的朋友、熟人和那些阴暗的犯罪黑幕联系人当初不把钱借给他才是对的。

shadowy.en: If Blackwater represented the corporate face of modern mercenaries, Wagner is something altogether different—a shadowy organisation that blends private military operations with state interests, operating in a legal and ethical grey zone.
shadowy.zh: 如果说黑水公司代表了现代雇佣兵的企业面孔，那么瓦格纳则完全是另一回事——一个将私人军事行动与国家利益融合在一起的暗影组织，游走于法律和道德的灰色地带。

shovel.en: My dad made me go shovel hay for a summer.
shovel.zh: 我爸爸让我去铲了一个夏天的干草。

shovel.en: This is not a question of whether there would be thousands of astronauts with hammers and shovels physically digging the surface themselves, and lugging large sacks back at the end of the day, but rather whether the mine would be 100% automated, controlled from back on Earth or from a space mission closer to Earth, or whether there would be human astronauts monitoring the situation from the site, just in case anything went wrong.
shovel.zh: 这并不是说会有成千上万的宇航员拿着锤子和铁锹亲自在表面挖掘，最后背着大麻袋回来，而是说这个矿场会是 100% 自动化的，由地球后方或距离地球更近的太空任务进行控制，亦或是会有宇航员在现场监控情况以防万一出现任何差错。

shoot.en: Shoot it using iPhones. We didn't even have like cameras.
shoot.zh: 用iPhone拍摄。我们甚至没有摄像机。

shoot.en: I remember you saying that the left had won the culture war and now they're just driving around shooting the survivors.
shoot.zh: 我记得你说过左派已经赢得了文化战争，现在他们只是在四处游荡，射杀幸存者。

shoot.en: And then all of a sudden life feels very short because you're like, shoot, there's like not that many things I can do before I die if I'm going to actually do my best.
shoot.zh: 突然间，人生感觉很短暂，因为你会想，天哪，如果我要真正做到最好，在我死之前我能做的事情并不多。

shoot.en: An interesting piece of trivia for you is that the record for the longest continuous film shoot is held by Stanley Kubrick, for his 1999 mystery thriller, Eyes Wide Shut.
shoot.zh: 一个有趣的冷知识是，最长连续电影拍摄纪录的保持者是斯坦利·库布里克（Stanley Kubrick），作品是他1999年的悬疑惊悚片《大开眼戒》（Eyes Wide Shut）。

shoot.en: If you need to build a settlement, it could be a lot more cost effective to take the raw materials from a nearby asteroid than shooting them up from a rocket on Earth.
shoot.zh: 如果你需要建立一个定居点，从附近的小行星获取原材料，要比用地球上的火箭发射成本划算得多。

shady.en: OK then, let’s get right into it and talk about the shady world of secret societies.
shady.zh: 好了，那我们马上切入正题，来聊聊秘密社团的神秘世界吧。

shady.en: In part one, this episode, we are going to be talking about the shady world of secret societies, and take a close look at three mysterious societies some people believe hold great power.
shady.zh: 在第一部分，也就是本期节目中，我们将探讨秘密社团的神秘世界，并仔细研究三个被一些人认为掌握着巨大权力的神秘组织。

shipwreck.en: The major objective was allowing people to dive down and recover valuables from shipwrecks.
shipwreck.zh: 主要目标是让人类能够潜入水下并从沉船中打捞贵重物品。

shipwreck.en: By this point in time, there were hundreds of known shipwrecks with valuable treasure, from ancient Roman shipwrecks through to ships that had only sunk the previous year.
shipwreck.zh: 到这个时候，有数百艘已知的沉船携带着宝贵的财富，从古罗马沉船到刚刚在前一年沉没的船只。

shore.en: They observed birds knowing that some species only fly a certain distance from shore.
shore.zh: 他们观察鸟类，知道某些物种只在离海岸一定距离的范围内飞行。

shore.en: They're down at the family's summer compound in Holland most days, a lake shore estate with a mansion filled with delicate objects.
shore.zh: 他们大部分时间都在霍兰德（Holland）的家族夏季大院里，那是一个湖滨庄园，里面有一座摆满精致物品的豪宅。

shore.en: It’s now believed that he swam a little out into the water and then swam along the shore to the beach of another hotel, retrieved his “getaway kit”, which he had stashed earlier, and then made a beeline for, he rushed to, Miami airport.
shore.zh: 现在人们认为，他先向海里游了一小段，然后沿着海岸游到另一家酒店的海滩，取回了他早先藏好的“逃跑装备”，然后直奔迈阿密机场。

shipbuilding.en: People working in shipbuilding or ship cleaning or in caregiving.
shipbuilding.zh: 有从事造船、船舶清洁或护理工作的人。
煤炭开采、钢铁制造、造船业。

shepherd.en: A steak and ale pie or a shepherd’s pie or a Cornish pasty are great.
shepherd.zh: 麦芽酒牛肉派（steak and ale pie）、牧羊人派（shepherd’s pie）或康沃尔肉馅饼（Cornish pasty）都很棒。

shipment.en: Kushim used writing to record shipments into and out of his warehouse.
shipment.zh: 库什姆用文字记录进出他仓库的货物运输。

shameful.en: In my personal opinion, Turing’s story, the way he was treated, is one of the most shameful stories in British history.
shameful.zh: 在我个人看来，Turing 的故事以及他所受到的对待，是英国历史上最可耻的故事之一。

shrine.en: But I don't want to live in a shrine to slavery.
shrine.zh: 但我不愿意生活在一座奴隶制的神龛里。

shrine.en: This has become a shrine to slavery.
shrine.zh: 这里已经成了一座奴隶制的神龛。

shortcoming.en: So, the shortcoming of the landline phone is that it's landline--it's in your house, and it stays there.
shortcoming.zh: 所以固定电话的缺陷就在于它是“固定”的——它待在你家里，也只能待在那儿。

shutter.en: But, they say, “You know what? I’m just going to shut it down for a while.” So, what does it mean to be a quitter as opposed to a “shutter downer?” Probably the same thing.
shutter.zh: 但是，他们会说，“你知道吗？我只是要暂时关闭它一段时间。”所以，作为一个“关机者”而不是一个“放弃者”意味着什么？可能是一回事。
